patterns.note: The homepage features a dominant three-column hero section, where each column acts as a primary navigation link to a major site category (Business, Consumer, About Us), each with a distinct background image and large text overlay.

Upon scrolling, the initial top bar containing the country/region selector slides up and out of view, while the main navigation bar simultaneously shrinks in height, gains a solid dark background, and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport.
A stark black and white color scheme dominates the site for text and backgrounds, providing high contrast, with the brand's distinctive yellow used exclusively for the Nikon logo.
Large, bold, sans-serif typography is consistently used for hero panel labels and section headings, establishing a clear and strong visual hierarchy.

technique_notes: The header implements a scroll-triggered transformation where an initial top bar is hidden, and the primary navigation bar reduces its vertical dimension and switches from a transparent to a solid dark background, fixing its position at the top of the screen.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for hero panels and section titles, with standard legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — the hero section is airy with large visual elements, while content sections like news lists and footers are more dense.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its three-panel hero section, which functions as a primary navigation hub, visually segmenting the company's core offerings (Business, Consumer, About Us) with large, impactful imagery and text. This creates a strong, immediate sense of corporate structure and purpose.
